import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
r=Path('experiments/results/kiss_matcher_validation')
protocol=json.loads((r/'protocol.json').read_text())
receipt=json.loads((r/'commands/run_pairs.json').read_text())
assert receipt['exit_code']==0 and receipt['tracked_dirty']==[]
source=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',receipt['source_commit']+':evaluation/scripts/run_official_kiss_matcher.py'])
assert source==Path('evaluation/scripts/run_official_kiss_matcher.py').read_bytes()
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('evaluation/scripts').resolve()))
from evaluate_external_kitti_odometry import load_reference_csv
gt=Path('experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_00_full_gt.csv')
assert hashlib.sha256(gt.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==protocol['reference_csv_sha256']
poses=load_reference_csv(gt)
summary=json.loads((r/'run/summary.json').read_text())
assert len(summary['cases'])==len(protocol['variants'])*len(protocol['cases'])
for row in summary['cases']:
 stem=row['variant']+'__'+row['case']
 job=json.loads((r/'run'/(stem+'.job.json')).read_text())
 assert 'reference' not in job and str(gt) not in json.dumps(job)
 assert '--reference-csv' not in row['argv'] and row['exit_code']==0
 result=json.loads((r/'run'/(stem+'.estimate.json')).read_text())
 assert result['backend_files'] and result['config']==job['expected_config']
 assert hashlib.sha256((r/'run'/(stem+'.estimate.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['estimate_sha256']
 case=job['case']
 if case['kind']=='synthetic':
  rng=np.random.default_rng(42);rng.uniform(-5,5,(5000,3))
  q,v=np.linalg.qr(rng.standard_normal((3,3)));rotation=q@np.diag(np.sign(np.diag(v)))
  if np.linalg.det(rotation)<0:rotation[:,0]*=-1
  expected=np.eye(4);expected[:3,:3]=rotation;expected[:3,3]=[1.5,-.7,.4]
 else:
  angle=np.radians(case['source_yaw_deg'])
  a=np.eye(4);a[:2,:2]=[[np.cos(angle),-np.sin(angle)],[np.sin(angle),np.cos(angle)]]
  expected=np.linalg.solve(poses[case['target_frame']],poses[case['source_frame']])@a.T
 estimate=np.array(result['transform'])
 assert np.isfinite(estimate).all() and np.allclose(estimate[3],[0,0,0,1])
 assert np.allclose(estimate[:3,:3].T@estimate[:3,:3],np.eye(3),atol=1e-5)
 assert abs(np.linalg.det(estimate[:3,:3])-1)<1e-5
 translation=float(np.linalg.norm(estimate[:3,3]-expected[:3,3]))
 rotation=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(expected[:3,:3].T@estimate[:3,:3])-1)/2,-1,1))))
 assert abs(translation-row['translation_error_m'])<1e-9
 assert abs(rotation-row['rotation_error_deg'])<1e-4
 assert row['success']==(rotation<=protocol['success_rotation_deg'] and translation<=protocol['success_translation_m'])
result={'all_cases_recomputed':True,'case_count':len(summary['cases']),'worker_gt_not_in_job_or_command':True,'runner_matches_execution_source':True}
(r/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
